assertions.subject: IL12 neutralization
assertions.source_locator: Abstract; Fig4A excerpt in search3.json

assertions.causal_directness: Cytokine neutralization in coculture; protein compartment and assay unavailable; source-specific IL12 manipulation not demonstrated.

assertions.subject: IL12
assertions.source_locator: Fig1B–D; Results: Myc-reactive Th1 TCCs ... Can Still Respond to IL12

assertions.cell_type: expanded mycobacterium-specific CD4 Th1 T-cell clone
assertions.stimulation: anti-CD2 plus anti-CD28 with or without IL12
assertions.uncertainty: Clone observations not independent donors.
assertions.causal_directness: Purified cytokine in activated clone cultures without accessory cells.
assertions.limitations: Expanded clones from 2 patients; not resting T cells or all IL12RB1 deficiency.

assertions.subject: IL12
assertions.source_locator: Fig1A–E; Results immediately following definition of response
assertions.evidence_summary: Two deficient clones, K4D8 and K3F12, repeatedly lacked an IL12 response under the tested stimulation modes.
assertions.cell_type: expanded mycobacterium-specific CD4 Th1 T-cell clone
assertions.cell_state: K4D8 and K3F12 clones under tested activation modes
assertions.stimulation: antigen or CD2/CD28 or CD3/CD28 activation
assertions.uncertainty: Clone observations not independent donors.
assertions.causal_directness: Purified cytokine perturbation with repeated clone-specific null responses.
assertions.limitations: Expanded clones from 2 patients; not resting T cells or all IL12RB1 deficiency. Study defined a response as >50% increase; null means no response by this criterion, not exact zero effect.

assertions.subject: IL12
assertions.source_locator: Fig7A–C; Stat4 Activation Methods
assertions.evidence_summary: IL12 did not induce detectable STAT4-containing DNA-binding complexes in IL12RB1-deficient blasts.
assertions.uncertainty: Small patient/control series; assay measures DNA-binding complexes, not phosphorylation.
assertions.causal_directness: Receptor-deficient versus control response; IFNA positive control.
assertions.limitations: Natural receptor deficiency; linked background differences; PHA blasts differ from T-cell clone secretion assay.

assertions.subject: IL12
assertions.source_locator: Fig7A–C; Stat4 Activation Methods
assertions.evidence_summary: IL12 induced STAT4-containing DNA-binding complexes in healthy-control blasts.
assertions.uncertainty: Small patient/control series; assay measures DNA-binding complexes, not phosphorylation.
assertions.causal_directness: Control arm of receptor-deficiency comparison.
assertions.limitations: Natural receptor deficiency; linked background differences; PHA blasts differ from T-cell clone secretion assay.

assertions.subject: IL10
assertions.source_locator: Fig6 caption and Results: IL10 Regulates IL10 mRNA but not TGFB mRNA Expression in Activated Monocytes; PMC2119001.txt lines 515–519 and 594–603
assertions.evidence_summary: After seven hours of LPS activation, added IL10 had no or only minimal inhibitory effect on IL10 mRNA, according to the authors' qualitative description.
assertions.uncertainty: Authors report no or minimal inhibition; no numeric estimate, confidence interval or equivalence bound extracted.
assertions.causal_directness: Purified cytokine perturbation with qualitative RNA readout; direct promoter regulation untested.
assertions.limitations: Qualitative Northern-blot contrast, not proof of zero effect or equivalence. Donor count unavailable. A distinct 24-hour experiment shows stronger inhibition and must remain a separate temporal context.

gaps.detail: Bounded pilot, not an exhaustive systematic review. Many priority cytokines have no narrow extracted human assertions: CSF2, IL16, IL17A, IL5, IL7, LTA, VEGF identity, IL13, IL1A, IL2, IL6, CCL11, CCL26, CCL13, CCL22, CCL3, CCL4, CCL17. Anchor inclusion does not certify coverage.
C-S05 and C-S07 remain needs_full_text; NCBI API supplied only abstracts and browser full text returned CAPTCHA. C-S04 OCR contains errors; numeric results deliberately not copied.
Human PBMC 24h versus mouse lymph-node 4h, different doses/tissues/species; no direct pooled prior or cross-species path. A549 findings are a separate transformed-cell context.
No inferred receptor availability from RNA; no secreted cytokine from RNA; no proliferation/cytotoxicity from gene programs. HCD and CytoSig communication predictions not entered as causal edges.
bioRxiv published=NA is repository linkage status, not proof no journal publication exists. Exact-title search plus two preprint records support preprint classification as of retrieval.
Older assays have unavailable independent donor totals. P1/P3/P4 patient data overlap historical publications. CytoSig reused primary studies require accession-level deduplication before expansion.
IL12 perturbation reagent label retained as IL12; do not equate unknown clinical IL12 assay channel with IL12p70. VEGF and high-range CXCL8 assay definitions require user/platform documentation.
No receptor-binding biochemistry, phosphoproteomic dose/time grids, ancestry stratification or full priority-set citation chaining completed in this pilot.

synthesis: The bounded cytokine pilot retains human perturbation evidence, measured secretion and functional coculture effects, and explicit null contrasts. Human and mouse dictionaries remain separate RNA resources. Engineered IL15/IL15RA presentation is distinguished from soluble IL15 and from intracellular IFNG. IL12RB1-deficient activated clones can retain responses while acute STAT4 DNA-binding induction is absent in PHA blasts. These are distinct contexts, not a resolved universal pathway. No complete multi-omic path or scientifically calibrated probability is claimed.
